summary: Shen Feizhi experiences a flashback to his past in a zombie-infested 'Small World' where he had to kill a former teammate to survive, reinforcing his belief that he exists to enable others to live at the cost of his own humanity. In the present, Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou travel to Pashimi for a trip. They decide to visit the restricted Interstellar Herb Garden. During the cable car ride, Gu Suizhou manipulates the seating arrangement to separate Shen Feizhi from Leapton (who is trying to pursue Shen Feizhi). Gu Suizhou intentionally breaks his own safety harness to stay in a separate cabin, revealing to the guide that his feelings for Shen Feizhi are 'orthopedic' (a slang term implying romantic/incestuous interest rather than familial).
